name: 82935 · Green River, WY
findings: ZIP 82935 (Green River) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82935 (Green River) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 82935 (Green River) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
